summary: REQ-4 is only partially implemented: a backend method exists and validates percentile, but it returns the wrong payload shape and wrong dummy rows/values. REQ-5 is partially evidenced (frontend calls backend and manages loading/error state), but the required `estimatedRank` is computed on the client rather than returned by the backend. REQ-6 (updating generated bindings/types for the actor interface) is not evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend predictor method must return an estimatedRank derived from percentile (documented placeholder formula) along with prediction rows.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend method `predictAdmission` returns only `[Prediction]` and does not include `estimatedRank` in its return value.

missing_requirements.requirement: Method returns exactly three dummy rows: (COEP, Mechanical, Dream), (VJTI, IT, Probable), (PCCOE, Computer, Safe).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend returns three different colleges/branches (IIT Madras CS, IIT Bombay EE, IIT Delhi Mechanical) and chances are computed conditionally rather than fixed to the specified values.

missing_requirements.requirement: UI displays the returned `estimatedRank` value near the results (returned from backend).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calculates `estimatedRank` locally instead of receiving it from the backend response; no evidence the backend returns it.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update generated frontend backend bindings/types (backendInterface used by `useActor`) to include the predictor method signature and response types matching the Motoko interface.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows updates to the generated backend bindings / actor interface typing to add the new method signature/return type; only the page code and backend actor are shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend method named `predictAdmission` returning only `[Prediction]` instead of the requested predictor API shape (e.g., `predict`) that also returns `estimatedRank`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies a predictor method (e.g., `predict`) that returns dummy predictions plus an `estimatedRank`; the implemented method name/payload does not match.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend computes chance dynamically based on `approxRank` thresholds rather than returning the fixed dummy chances Dream/Probable/Safe for the specified three rows.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 requires exactly the three dummy rows with fixed chance labels; the diff shows conditional chance logic per row.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend dummy colleges/branches changed to IIT Madras/IIT Bombay/IIT Delhi instead of COEP/VJTI/PCCOE specified by the request.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 explicitly lists required dummy rows; implemented rows differ.
